key: wing commander - platinum edition (1992)(mindscape)(disk 1 of 3)[h lsd][a]/Wing Commander - Platinum Edition (1992)(Mindscape)(Disk 1 of 3)[h LSD][a].adf:c/setpatchV38.31:0:0AE4
name: complete_request_or_forward_handler
description: Checks a request state word and, when it matches the completion case, copies two stored fields, clears a flag and calls a library vector. Any other request is passed on through the saved original handler, so the routine acts as a pass-through wrapper.

key: wing commander - platinum edition (1992)(mindscape)(disk 1 of 3)[h lsd][a]/Wing Commander - Platinum Edition (1992)(Mindscape)(Disk 1 of 3)[h LSD][a].adf:c/setpatchV38.31:0:0AE8
name: finish_request_or_forward_handler
description: Repeats the same state check and completion steps as its neighbour, clearing the flag and calling the library vector on a match. Non-matching requests tail-jump through the saved original handler.

key: wing commander - platinum edition (1992)(mindscape)(disk 1 of 3)[h lsd][a]/Wing Commander - Platinum Edition (1992)(Mindscape)(Disk 1 of 3)[h LSD][a].adf:c/setpatchV38.31:0:0AFE
name: reply_message_or_forward_handler
description: Runs the completion steps directly when a status byte matches, copying fields, clearing flags and calling a library vector that replies to the message. Otherwise it forwards the call to the saved original handler.

key: wing commander - platinum edition (1992)(mindscape)(disk 1 of 3)[h lsd][a]/Wing Commander - Platinum Edition (1992)(Mindscape)(Disk 1 of 3)[h LSD][a].adf:c/setpatchV38.31:0:0B42
name: finish_unflagged_request_or_forward
description: When a flag word at a fixed offset is zero, it copies a stored field, clears a flag byte and calls a library vector. Otherwise it jumps through the saved original handler.

key: wing commander - platinum edition (1992)(mindscape)(disk 1 of 3)[h lsd][a]/Wing Commander - Platinum Edition (1992)(Mindscape)(Disk 1 of 3)[h LSD][a].adf:c/setpatchV38.31:0:0B8C
name: call_cia_routine_twice
description: Calls the same unnamed routine twice in a row and returns zero. The referenced names ciaa.resource and ciab.resource show that the callee deals with the two CIA chip resources.

key: wing commander - platinum edition (1992)(mindscape)(disk 1 of 3)[h lsd][a]/Wing Commander - Platinum Edition (1992)(Mindscape)(Disk 1 of 3)[h LSD][a].adf:c/setpatchV38.31:0:0BAA
name: claim_flagged_structure_once
description: Fetches a structure through a library call and, if the pointer is non-null and its flag byte is negative, sets that flag, passes the structure to a library routine and then clears the flag again. It returns the structure pointer.

key: wing commander - platinum edition (1992)(mindscape)(disk 1 of 3)[h lsd][a]/Wing Commander - Platinum Edition (1992)(Mindscape)(Disk 1 of 3)[h LSD][a].adf:c/setpatchV38.31:0:0C7C
name: forward_to_unnamed_routine
description: Two-instruction wrapper that transfers control to one other routine with no other visible effect. The decompiler timed out, so only its call and its callers are known.

key: wing commander - platinum edition (1992)(mindscape)(disk 1 of 3)[h lsd][a]/Wing Commander - Platinum Edition (1992)(Mindscape)(Disk 1 of 3)[h LSD][a].adf:c/setpatchV38.31:0:0C8A
name: jump_through_fixed_vector
description: Five-instruction relay that calls a single jump-table entry, which passes control straight on to a fixed address elsewhere in memory. Callers use it to reach that address through this routine.

key: wing commander - platinum edition (1992)(mindscape)(disk 1 of 3)[h lsd][a]/Wing Commander - Platinum Edition (1992)(Mindscape)(Disk 1 of 3)[h LSD][a].adf:c/setpatchV38.31:0:0D24
name: cache_console_device_handle
description: Calls a library routine and, when it returns a non-null pointer, saves that pointer, a value read from its sixth longword, and the caller's base pointer into three global slots. The console.device text reference shows which device is involved.

key: wing commander - platinum edition (1992)(mindscape)(disk 1 of 3)[h lsd][a]/Wing Commander - Platinum Edition (1992)(Mindscape)(Disk 1 of 3)[h LSD][a].adf:c/setpatchV38.31:0:0D48
name: dispatch_in_range_or_forward
description: Compares a value with lower and upper bounds held in globals. Inside the range it calls a library vector and, on a non-zero result, runs a nested routine and a second vector; outside the range it jumps through the saved original vector.

key: wing commander - platinum edition (1992)(mindscape)(disk 1 of 3)[h lsd][a]/Wing Commander - Platinum Edition (1992)(Mindscape)(Disk 1 of 3)[h LSD][a].adf:c/setpatchV38.31:0:0D50
name: pass_through_saved_vector
description: Jumps straight through a saved vector pointer, handing control to the previously installed routine without changing any arguments.

key: wing commander - platinum edition (1992)(mindscape)(disk 1 of 3)[h lsd][a]/Wing Commander - Platinum Edition (1992)(Mindscape)(Disk 1 of 3)[h LSD][a].adf:c/setpatchV38.31:0:0D56
name: dispatch_below_limit_or_forward
description: Compares the data register with an upper bound stored in a global. Within the bound it calls a library vector and, on a non-zero result, runs a nested routine and a second vector; otherwise it jumps through the saved original vector.

key: wing commander - platinum edition (1992)(mindscape)(disk 1 of 3)[h lsd][a]/Wing Commander - Platinum Edition (1992)(Mindscape)(Disk 1 of 3)[h LSD][a].adf:c/setpatchV38.31:0:0E10
name: store_offset_from_library_result
description: Chooses one of two fixed offsets depending on whether a field equals a particular value, adds it to the pointer returned by a library call, and stores the result in a global when that call succeeded. The dos.library reference shows the library involved.

key: wing commander - platinum edition (1992)(mindscape)(disk 1 of 3)[h lsd][a]/Wing Commander - Platinum Edition (1992)(Mindscape)(Disk 1 of 3)[h LSD][a].adf:c/setpatchV38.31:0:0E3E
name: clear_matching_slot_entry
description: Uses the data register, scaled by four, as an index into a table. When the indexed entry equals a stored global value, it sets the two following fields to minus one.

key: wing commander - platinum edition (1992)(mindscape)(disk 1 of 3)[h lsd][a]/Wing Commander - Platinum Edition (1992)(Mindscape)(Disk 1 of 3)[h LSD][a].adf:c/setpatchV38.31:0:0E42
name: clear_slot_or_forward
description: Looks up a table entry by the scaled data-register index and, if it matches the stored global, sets its two following fields to minus one. Otherwise it jumps through the saved original vector.

key: wing commander - platinum edition (1992)(mindscape)(disk 1 of 3)[h lsd][a]/Wing Commander - Platinum Edition (1992)(Mindscape)(Disk 1 of 3)[h LSD][a].adf:c/setpatchV38.31:0:0E46
name: clear_slot_then_forward_nested
description: Performs the same indexed table check, and on a match clears the two following fields. It then sends the call on through the saved vector as a nested dispatch, with the same matching behaviour as its neighbour.

key: wing commander - platinum edition (1992)(mindscape)(disk 1 of 3)[h lsd][a]/Wing Commander - Platinum Edition (1992)(Mindscape)(Disk 1 of 3)[h LSD][a].adf:c/setpatchV38.31:0:0E62
name: jump_through_saved_vector_again
description: Two-instruction routine that jumps through the saved original vector pointer, passing control to the earlier handler unchanged.

key: wing commander - platinum edition (1992)(mindscape)(disk 1 of 3)[h lsd][a]/Wing Commander - Platinum Edition (1992)(Mindscape)(Disk 1 of 3)[h LSD][a].adf:c/setpatchV38.31:0:0EC0
name: sequence_intena_calls_return_one
description: Calls three library routines in sequence and stores the constant 64 in a global between two of those calls. Its facts list the INTENA interrupt-enable register as touched, so the sequence appears to manage interrupts, and it returns one.

key: wing commander - platinum edition (1992)(mindscape)(disk 1 of 3)[h lsd][a]/Wing Commander - Platinum Edition (1992)(Mindscape)(Disk 1 of 3)[h LSD][a].adf:c/setpatchV38.31:0:0F78
name: save_argument_into_global_slot
description: Copies its input register into a global variable and returns one.

key: wing commander - platinum edition (1992)(mindscape)(disk 1 of 3)[h lsd][a]/Wing Commander - Platinum Edition (1992)(Mindscape)(Disk 1 of 3)[h LSD][a].adf:c/setpatchV38.31:0:0F82
name: refresh_pattern_buffer_on_change
description: Reads a value through a library call and compares it with a cached copy for the selected index. When the value changed and equals the alternating-bit pattern, and a structure pointer is set, it fills 830 longwords of that structure's buffer with the same pattern.

key: wing commander - platinum edition (1992)(mindscape)(disk 1 of 3)[h lsd][a]/Wing Commander - Platinum Edition (1992)(Mindscape)(Disk 1 of 3)[h LSD][a].adf:c/setpatchV38.31:0:0F86
name: stub_single_instruction_handler
description: The facts describe a one-instruction routine reached through a handler pointer in data, with two unnamed callers. The attached pseudo-code is a longer body that does not match those facts, so no further behaviour is claimed.

key: wing commander - platinum edition (1992)(mindscape)(disk 1 of 3)[h lsd][a]/Wing Commander - Platinum Edition (1992)(Mindscape)(Disk 1 of 3)[h LSD][a].adf:c/setpatchV38.31:0:0F9A
name: update_pattern_cache_and_fill
description: Calls an unnamed routine for a value and, when it differs from the cached value for the indexed entry, updates the cache. If the new value equals the alternating-bit sentinel and a buffer pointer is set, it fills 830 longwords of that buffer with the same pattern.

key: wing commander - platinum edition (1992)(mindscape)(disk 1 of 3)[h lsd][a]/Wing Commander - Platinum Edition (1992)(Mindscape)(Disk 1 of 3)[h LSD][a].adf:c/setpatchV38.31:0:1074
name: add_library_result_twice
description: Calls a library routine and, when it returns a non-zero value, adds that value into one global slot twice. The intuition.library reference shows the library the call relates to.

key: wing commander - platinum edition (1992)(mindscape)(disk 1 of 3)[h lsd][a]/Wing Commander - Platinum Edition (1992)(Mindscape)(Disk 1 of 3)[h LSD][a].adf:c/setpatchV38.31:0:108E
name: update_on_matching_message_code
description: Checks a stack argument and the second argument against two fixed codes, and when both match and a flags word has bit three or four set, copies one stored field into another. It increments a one-byte counter in the caller's structure on every call.

key: wing commander - platinum edition (1992)(mindscape)(disk 1 of 3)[h lsd][a]/Wing Commander - Platinum Edition (1992)(Mindscape)(Disk 1 of 3)[h LSD][a].adf:c/setpatchV38.31:0:109C
name: copy_field_on_code_match
description: When the second argument equals a fixed code and a flags word has bit three or four set, copies one stored field into another. It then increments a one-byte counter in the caller's structure on every call.

key: wing commander - platinum edition (1992)(mindscape)(disk 1 of 3)[h lsd][a]/Wing Commander - Platinum Edition (1992)(Mindscape)(Disk 1 of 3)[h LSD][a].adf:c/setpatchV38.31:0:1114
name: clear_flag_bit_on_target
description: Chooses a target pointer from a library call when a flag bit is set, otherwise uses a fixed low address. It clears bit zero of the longword there and then calls a second library routine.

key: wing commander - platinum edition (1992)(mindscape)(disk 1 of 3)[h lsd][a]/Wing Commander - Platinum Edition (1992)(Mindscape)(Disk 1 of 3)[h LSD][a].adf:c/setpatchV38.31:0:1230
name: search_list_by_word_key
description: Calls a library routine, then walks a linked list of nodes looking for one whose stored halfword matches the key in the data register. It returns the passed value when a match is found and zero otherwise.

key: wing commander - platinum edition (1992)(mindscape)(disk 1 of 3)[h lsd][a]/Wing Commander - Platinum Edition (1992)(Mindscape)(Disk 1 of 3)[h LSD][a].adf:c/setpatchV38.31:0:1234
name: search_list_after_empty_hook
description: Calls an empty routine that does nothing, then walks a linked list for a node whose halfword matches the key in the data register. It returns the passed value on a match and zero otherwise.

key: wing commander - platinum edition (1992)(mindscape)(disk 1 of 3)[h lsd][a]/Wing Commander - Platinum Edition (1992)(Mindscape)(Disk 1 of 3)[h LSD][a].adf:c/setpatchV38.31:0:1246
name: search_list_for_matching_word
description: Calls a library routine and scans a linked list for a node whose stored halfword equals the data-register key. It returns the passed value when found and zero when not.

key: wing commander - platinum edition (1992)(mindscape)(disk 1 of 3)[h lsd][a]/Wing Commander - Platinum Edition (1992)(Mindscape)(Disk 1 of 3)[h LSD][a].adf:c/setpatchV38.31:0:124A
name: search_list_with_two_calls
description: Makes two library calls around a scan of a linked list of nodes, matching each node's halfword against the key in the data register. It returns the passed value on a match and zero otherwise.

key: wing commander - platinum edition (1992)(mindscape)(disk 1 of 3)[h lsd][a]/Wing Commander - Platinum Edition (1992)(Mindscape)(Disk 1 of 3)[h LSD][a].adf:c/setpatchV38.31:0:1250
name: search_list_unless_second_arg
description: Returns the second argument unchanged when it is non-zero. Otherwise it calls a library routine, scans a linked list for a node whose halfword matches the data-register key, and returns the passed value or zero.

key: wing commander - platinum edition (1992)(mindscape)(disk 1 of 3)[h lsd][a]/Wing Commander - Platinum Edition (1992)(Mindscape)(Disk 1 of 3)[h LSD][a].adf:c/setpatchV38.31:0:1254
name: search_list_unless_arg_hook
description: Like its neighbour, returns immediately when the second argument is non-zero. Otherwise it calls an empty routine, then a library routine, and scans a linked list for a matching halfword key.

key: wing commander - platinum edition (1992)(mindscape)(disk 1 of 3)[h lsd][a]/Wing Commander - Platinum Edition (1992)(Mindscape)(Disk 1 of 3)[h LSD][a].adf:c/setpatchV38.31:0:1268
name: search_list_return_two_default
description: Calls a library routine, scans a linked list for a node whose halfword matches the data-register key, and calls a second library routine. It returns the passed value on a match and two when nothing is found.

key: wing commander - platinum edition (1992)(mindscape)(disk 1 of 3)[h lsd][a]/Wing Commander - Platinum Edition (1992)(Mindscape)(Disk 1 of 3)[h LSD][a].adf:c/setpatchV38.31:0:126C
name: search_list_returning_two
description: Runs a linked-list scan with a library call before and after it, matching the data-register key against a stored halfword. It returns the passed value on a match and two otherwise.

key: wing commander - platinum edition (1992)(mindscape)(disk 1 of 3)[h lsd][a]/Wing Commander - Platinum Edition (1992)(Mindscape)(Disk 1 of 3)[h LSD][a].adf:c/setpatchV38.31:0:1278
name: search_list_signed_minus_one
description: Returns minus one at once when the data register holds minus one. Otherwise it scans a linked list for a node whose halfword matches the key and returns the passed value, or minus one when nothing matches.

key: wing commander - platinum edition (1992)(mindscape)(disk 1 of 3)[h lsd][a]/Wing Commander - Platinum Edition (1992)(Mindscape)(Disk 1 of 3)[h LSD][a].adf:c/setpatchV38.31:0:127C
name: search_list_signed_after_hook
description: Returns minus one for an input of minus one. Otherwise it calls an empty routine and a library routine, scans a linked list for the matching halfword, and returns the passed value or minus one.

key: wing commander - platinum edition (1992)(mindscape)(disk 1 of 3)[h lsd][a]/Wing Commander - Platinum Edition (1992)(Mindscape)(Disk 1 of 3)[h LSD][a].adf:c/setpatchV38.31:0:1290
name: search_list_zero_default
description: Calls a library routine, scans a linked list for a node whose halfword matches the data-register key, and calls a second library routine. It returns the passed value on a match and zero otherwise.

key: wing commander - platinum edition (1992)(mindscape)(disk 1 of 3)[h lsd][a]/Wing Commander - Platinum Edition (1992)(Mindscape)(Disk 1 of 3)[h LSD][a].adf:c/setpatchV38.31:0:1294
name: search_list_with_two_hooks
description: Runs a linked-list scan for a halfword matching the data-register key, bracketed by two unnamed routine calls. It returns the passed value on a match and zero otherwise.

key: wing commander - platinum edition (1992)(mindscape)(disk 1 of 3)[h lsd][a]/Wing Commander - Platinum Edition (1992)(Mindscape)(Disk 1 of 3)[h LSD][a].adf:c/setpatchV38.31:0:129A
name: search_list_return_argument_default
description: Calls a library routine, scans a linked list for a node whose halfword matches the data-register key, and calls a second library routine. It returns the passed argument when nothing is found.

key: wing commander - platinum edition (1992)(mindscape)(disk 1 of 3)[h lsd][a]/Wing Commander - Platinum Edition (1992)(Mindscape)(Disk 1 of 3)[h LSD][a].adf:c/setpatchV38.31:0:12CA
name: return_stack_value_if_present
description: Calls a library routine and returns the first stacked argument when its result is non-null, otherwise returns the third argument. A small helper that pops the stacked value is also part of the sequence.

key: wing commander - platinum edition (1992)(mindscape)(disk 1 of 3)[h lsd][a]/Wing Commander - Platinum Edition (1992)(Mindscape)(Disk 1 of 3)[h LSD][a].adf:c/setpatchV38.31:0:1338
name: locate_word_entry_in_table
description: Picks a base pointer from a fixed offset or a library call, depending on a flag bit, then scans forward through halfwords for a stored value and saves that position. It calls a library routine and returns one; the referenced text names an NsDOS open call.

key: wing commander - platinum edition (1992)(mindscape)(disk 1 of 3)[h lsd][a]/Wing Commander - Platinum Edition (1992)(Mindscape)(Disk 1 of 3)[h LSD][a].adf:c/setpatchV38.31:0:13DC
name: check_patched_branch_or_forward
description: Reads the first word at a stored patch target. When that word is not the branch-to-subroutine opcode, control jumps through the saved original vector; otherwise the routine calls the neighbouring unnamed routine.

key: wing commander - platinum edition (1992)(mindscape)(disk 1 of 3)[h lsd][a]/Wing Commander - Platinum Edition (1992)(Mindscape)(Disk 1 of 3)[h LSD][a].adf:c/setpatchV38.31:0:13E0
name: check_patched_branch_then_forward
description: Performs the same opcode check on a stored target. A mismatch jumps through the saved original vector and a match calls the neighbouring unnamed routine instead.

key: wing commander - platinum edition (1992)(mindscape)(disk 1 of 3)[h lsd][a]/Wing Commander - Platinum Edition (1992)(Mindscape)(Disk 1 of 3)[h LSD][a].adf:c/setpatchV38.31:0:13EC
name: relay_to_unnamed_routine
description: Calls one unnamed routine and returns. The seven-instruction count suggests more code than the pseudo-code shows, so only the call is claimed.

key: wing commander - platinum edition (1992)(mindscape)(disk 1 of 3)[h lsd][a]/Wing Commander - Platinum Edition (1992)(Mindscape)(Disk 1 of 3)[h LSD][a].adf:c/setpatchV38.31:0:13FE
name: convert_c_string_to_bcpl
description: Measures a null-terminated C string and copies it into a newly allocated buffer as a length-prefixed string, with a zero after the last character. If allocation fails it frees the memory and returns zero; otherwise it passes the buffer to a second routine, using exec.AllocVec and exec.FreeVec.

key: wing commander - platinum edition (1992)(mindscape)(disk 1 of 3)[h lsd][a]/Wing Commander - Platinum Edition (1992)(Mindscape)(Disk 1 of 3)[h LSD][a].adf:c/setpatchV38.31:0:144C
name: write_bcpl_string_to_buffer
description: Measures a null-terminated C string and writes it into a caller-supplied buffer as a length-prefixed string, placing the length byte first. It then writes a zero terminator and calls a second routine.

key: wing commander - platinum edition (1992)(mindscape)(disk 1 of 3)[h lsd][a]/Wing Commander - Platinum Edition (1992)(Mindscape)(Disk 1 of 3)[h LSD][a].adf:c/setpatchV38.31:0:1472
name: copy_bytes_backwards_terminated
description: Copies a run of bytes backwards from the end of one buffer into another, stores a byte passed in a data register in front of the copy, and writes a zero terminator. It then calls a second routine.

key: wing commander - platinum edition (1992)(mindscape)(disk 1 of 3)[h lsd][a]/Wing Commander - Platinum Edition (1992)(Mindscape)(Disk 1 of 3)[h LSD][a].adf:c/setpatchV38.31:0:1490
name: stub_immediate_return
description: A three-instruction routine that performs no work and returns straight away to its single unnamed caller.

key: wing commander - platinum edition (1992)(mindscape)(disk 1 of 3)[h lsd][a]/Wing Commander - Platinum Edition (1992)(Mindscape)(Disk 1 of 3)[h LSD][a].adf:c/setpatchV38.31:0:14FC
name: forward_library_call_pair_result
description: Calls a library routine and returns its two result registers together as one 64-bit value. The call-set-signal routine is one of the callers.

key: wing commander - platinum edition (1992)(mindscape)(disk 1 of 3)[h lsd][a]/Wing Commander - Platinum Edition (1992)(Mindscape)(Disk 1 of 3)[h LSD][a].adf:c/setpatchV38.31:0:1598
name: drain_flagged_list_nodes
description: Increments a global activity counter and decrements a per-structure count. When the count reaches zero, it removes nodes from a linked list, calling a library routine for each node with a flag bit set and relinking the list.

key: wing commander - platinum edition (1992)(mindscape)(disk 1 of 3)[h lsd][a]/Wing Commander - Platinum Edition (1992)(Mindscape)(Disk 1 of 3)[h LSD][a].adf:c/setpatchV38.31:0:15B0
name: branch_on_sign_decrement_counter
description: When the sign flag is set it calls two library routines; otherwise it decrements a 16-bit counter in the caller's structure. It then tail-calls a further library routine.

key: wing commander - platinum edition (1992)(mindscape)(disk 1 of 3)[h lsd][a]/Wing Commander - Platinum Edition (1992)(Mindscape)(Disk 1 of 3)[h LSD][a].adf:c/setpatchV38.31:0:15B8
name: call_alert_and_init_semaphore
description: Calls two library routines that the facts identify as exec.Alert and exec.InitSemaphore, then a third library routine, and returns. The pseudo-code order does not show which call maps to which routine.

key: wing commander - platinum edition (1992)(mindscape)(disk 1 of 3)[h lsd][a]/Wing Commander - Platinum Edition (1992)(Mindscape)(Disk 1 of 3)[h LSD][a].adf:c/setpatchV38.31:0:15DA
name: unlink_first_flagged_node
description: Removes the first node from a linked list in the caller's structure. When that node's flag bit is set, it loops over the following nodes with a library call and relinks them, then calls a further library routine.

key: wing commander - platinum edition (1992)(mindscape)(disk 1 of 3)[h lsd][a]/Wing Commander - Platinum Edition (1992)(Mindscape)(Disk 1 of 3)[h LSD][a].adf:c/setpatchV38.31:0:1612
name: walk_list_until_terminator
description: Walks a linked list from the head pointer in the caller's structure, calling a library routine on each node and relinking as it goes. When the list ends it finishes with a tail call to a library routine.

key: wing commander - platinum edition (1992)(mindscape)(disk 1 of 3)[h lsd][a]/Wing Commander - Platinum Edition (1992)(Mindscape)(Disk 1 of 3)[h LSD][a].adf:c/setpatchV38.31:0:1640
name: advance_count_clear_status_bit
description: Increments a per-structure count and, once it is non-zero and a pointer is set, clears bit four of a status byte and calls two library routines. Otherwise it increments a second counter and tail-calls a library routine.

key: wing commander - platinum edition (1992)(mindscape)(disk 1 of 3)[h lsd][a]/Wing Commander - Platinum Edition (1992)(Mindscape)(Disk 1 of 3)[h LSD][a].adf:c/setpatchV38.31:0:1652
name: clear_status_bit_or_count
description: When a pointer in the caller's structure is set, it clears bit four of a status byte, calls two library routines and tail-calls a third. Otherwise it increments a counter and tail-calls a library routine.

key: wing commander - platinum edition (1992)(mindscape)(disk 1 of 3)[h lsd][a]/Wing Commander - Platinum Edition (1992)(Mindscape)(Disk 1 of 3)[h LSD][a].adf:c/setpatchV38.31:0:1720
name: check_stack_bounds_then_forward
description: Compares the address of a local variable with the lower and upper stack bounds stored in the task structure, and checks a flag word for minus one. When the stack is out of bounds or the flag is set, it calls the saved original routine and returns its byte result.

key: wing commander - platinum edition (1992)(mindscape)(disk 1 of 3)[h lsd][a]/Wing Commander - Platinum Edition (1992)(Mindscape)(Disk 1 of 3)[h LSD][a].adf:c/setpatchV38.31:0:1724
name: check_stack_bounds_then_call
description: Performs the same stack bound and flag-word test as its neighbour. When the test fails it calls the saved original routine and returns nothing.

key: wing commander - platinum edition (1992)(mindscape)(disk 1 of 3)[h lsd][a]/Wing Commander - Platinum Edition (1992)(Mindscape)(Disk 1 of 3)[h LSD][a].adf:c/setpatchV38.31:0:174C
name: check_stack_bounds_forward_result
description: Applies the same stack bounds and flag-word test, and when it triggers it calls the saved original routine and returns the byte it produces.

key: wing commander - platinum edition (1992)(mindscape)(disk 1 of 3)[h lsd][a]/Wing Commander - Platinum Edition (1992)(Mindscape)(Disk 1 of 3)[h LSD][a].adf:c/setpatchV38.31:0:1750
name: check_stack_bounds_then_relay
description: Tests the local-variable address against the stack bounds and the flag word for minus one. On a failed test it calls the saved original routine and returns.

key: wing commander - platinum edition (1992)(mindscape)(disk 1 of 3)[h lsd][a]/Wing Commander - Platinum Edition (1992)(Mindscape)(Disk 1 of 3)[h LSD][a].adf:c/setpatchV38.31:0:1814
name: save_a1_and_base_globals
description: Stores the A1 argument and the A6 base register into two global slots and returns one. The facts also list a two-instruction helper among its calls.

key: wing commander - platinum edition (1992)(mindscape)(disk 1 of 3)[h lsd][a]/Wing Commander - Platinum Edition (1992)(Mindscape)(Disk 1 of 3)[h LSD][a].adf:c/setpatchV38.31:0:1828
name: relay_call_to_neighbour
description: Three-instruction routine that transfers control to one other unnamed routine. The decompiler timed out, so no further behaviour is described.

key: wing commander - platinum edition (1992)(mindscape)(disk 1 of 3)[h lsd][a]/Wing Commander - Platinum Edition (1992)(Mindscape)(Disk 1 of 3)[h LSD][a].adf:c/setpatchV38.31:0:1838
name: call_unnamed_routine_after_helper
description: Eleven-instruction routine that calls a two-instruction helper and one unnamed routine. The decompiler timed out, so its logic is described only by those calls.

key: wing commander - platinum edition (1992)(mindscape)(disk 1 of 3)[h lsd][a]/Wing Commander - Platinum Edition (1992)(Mindscape)(Disk 1 of 3)[h LSD][a].adf:c/Version:0:0000
name: startup_allocate_and_open_dos
description: Program entry that finds the current task, allocates a memory block and opens dos.library, returning an error code on failure. The main work is handed to two unnamed routines, and the facts also list an alert call.

key: wing commander - platinum edition (1992)(mindscape)(disk 1 of 3)[h lsd][a]/Wing Commander - Platinum Edition (1992)(Mindscape)(Disk 1 of 3)[h LSD][a].adf:c/Version:0:0172
name: swap_task_slot_with_cleanup
description: Stores its argument in a per-task slot and returns that slot's value after running cleanup calls. When a second field is set it calls two more library routines, and the facts list calls for closing, freeing and replying to a message.

key: wing commander - platinum edition (1992)(mindscape)(disk 1 of 3)[h lsd][a]/Wing Commander - Platinum Edition (1992)(Mindscape)(Disk 1 of 3)[h LSD][a].adf:c/Version:2:0000
name: parse_args_check_library_version
description: Reads command-line arguments and prints a usage line when asked. It then opens the requested library or device, compares its version and revision with the arguments, and prints version or error messages for the Kickstart, Workbench or device case.

key: wing commander - platinum edition (1992)(mindscape)(disk 1 of 3)[h lsd][a]/Wing Commander - Platinum Edition (1992)(Mindscape)(Disk 1 of 3)[h LSD][a].adf:c/Version:2:0352
name: call_library_then_unnamed_routine
description: Calls a library routine with the first argument and a fixed flag value of 128, then passes the second argument to one unnamed routine. The code does not show a clearer purpose.

key: wing commander - platinum edition (1992)(mindscape)(disk 1 of 3)[h lsd][a]/Wing Commander - Platinum Edition (1992)(Mindscape)(Disk 1 of 3)[h LSD][a].adf:c/Version:2:0378
name: parse_signed_decimal_string
description: Converts a string to an integer by reading an optional plus or minus sign and then decimal digits. The result is negated for a minus sign and returned.

key: wing commander - platinum edition (1992)(mindscape)(disk 1 of 3)[h lsd][a]/Wing Commander - Platinum Edition (1992)(Mindscape)(Disk 1 of 3)[h LSD][a].adf:c/Version:2:03EE
name: compare_null_terminated_strings
description: Compares two null-terminated strings byte by byte. It returns minus one when the first is lower, one when it is higher, and zero when they are equal.

key: wing commander - platinum edition (1992)(mindscape)(disk 1 of 3)[h lsd][a]/Wing Commander - Platinum Edition (1992)(Mindscape)(Disk 1 of 3)[h LSD][a].adf:c/Version:2:0414
name: measure_null_terminated_length
description: Walks a null-terminated string and returns the number of characters before the terminator.

key: wing commander - platinum edition (1992)(mindscape)(disk 1 of 3)[h lsd][a]/Wing Commander - Platinum Edition (1992)(Mindscape)(Disk 1 of 3)[h LSD][a].adf:c/Version:8:001C
name: call_exec_dispatch_vector
description: Calls the exec.Dispatch routine through the library base stored in a global, with no arguments set up here.

key: wing commander - platinum edition (1992)(mindscape)(disk 1 of 3)[h lsd][a]/Wing Commander - Platinum Edition (1992)(Mindscape)(Disk 1 of 3)[h LSD][a].adf:c/Version:5:0000
name: forward_with_stack_pointer_argument
description: Passes its two arguments to one unnamed routine together with the address of a stack location, then returns. Two unnamed routines call it.

key: wing commander - platinum edition (1992)(mindscape)(disk 1 of 3)[h lsd][a]/Wing Commander - Platinum Edition (1992)(Mindscape)(Disk 1 of 3)[h LSD][a].adf:c/Version:9:0000
name: call_exec_vector_198
description: Calls the exec library routine at offset 198 from the exec base held in a global, and returns its result. It is a single relay with no other work.

name: call_exec_vector_210
description: Calls the exec library routine at offset 210 from the exec base held in a global, and returns its result. It is a single relay with no other work.

name: call_exec_vector_414
description: Calls the exec library routine at offset 414 from the exec base held in a global, and returns its result. It is a single relay with no other work.

name: call_exec_vector_444
description: Calls the exec library routine at offset 444 from the exec base held in a global, and returns its result. It is a single relay with no other work.

name: call_exec_vector_450
description: Calls the exec library routine at offset 450 from the exec base held in a global, and returns its result. It is a single relay with no other work.

name: call_exec_vector_552
description: Calls the exec library routine at offset 552 from the exec base held in a global, and returns its result. It is a single relay with no other work.

key: wing commander - platinum edition (1992)(mindscape)(disk 1 of 3)[h lsd][a]/Wing Commander - Platinum Edition (1992)(Mindscape)(Disk 1 of 3)[h LSD][a].adf:c/Version:4:0000
name: format_text_and_emit_length
description: Formats text into a 140-byte stack buffer with the exec formatted-output routine, then measures the resulting string. When the string is not empty it passes the buffer and its length to one unnamed routine.

key: wing commander - platinum edition (1992)(mindscape)(disk 1 of 3)[h lsd][a]/Wing Commander - Platinum Edition (1992)(Mindscape)(Disk 1 of 3)[h LSD][a].adf:c/Version:4:004C
name: store_byte_at_output_pointer
description: Stores the low byte of the data register at the location given by the address register and returns. Its shape is that of a character-output callback, and the facts show one caller and no library calls.

key: wing commander - platinum edition (1992)(mindscape)(disk 1 of 3)[h lsd][a]/Wing Commander - Platinum Edition (1992)(Mindscape)(Disk 1 of 3)[h LSD][a].adf:devs/keymaps/d:0:0000
name: stub_bad_instruction_data
description: The attached pseudo-code decodes to invalid instructions, so it is bad data rather than a routine. The only usable fact is that this 13-instruction entry sits in a keymap device file.

key: wing commander - platinum edition (1992)(mindscape)(disk 1 of 3)[h lsd][a]/Wing Commander - Platinum Edition (1992)(Mindscape)(Disk 1 of 3)[h LSD][a].adf:InstallWingCommander:0:0000
name: startup_clear_state_open_dos
description: Program entry for the installer that zeroes a large global state block and works out a stack-based layout. It then opens dos.library, duplicates a directory lock and waits on a message port, handing the rest of the work to three unnamed routines.

key: wing commander - platinum edition (1992)(mindscape)(disk 1 of 3)[h lsd][a]/Wing Commander - Platinum Edition (1992)(Mindscape)(Disk 1 of 3)[h LSD][a].adf:InstallWingCommander:0:01BE
name: release_install_state_and_reply
description: Stores its argument in a stack slot and runs cleanup: it calls an optional callback, two unnamed routines and, when a flag is set, a further library routine. The facts list unlock, close, free-memory and reply calls among its library calls.

key: wing commander - platinum edition (1992)(mindscape)(disk 1 of 3)[h lsd][a]/Wing Commander - Platinum Edition (1992)(Mindscape)(Disk 1 of 3)[h LSD][a].adf:InstallWingCommander:0:0260
name: walk_entry_chain_with_delay
description: Checks remaining stack space before walking a chain of entries, calling a set of helper routines on each one. It also calls a delay library routine, and the helpers' roles are not visible in the pseudo-code.

key: wing commander - platinum edition (1992)(mindscape)(disk 1 of 3)[h lsd][a]/Wing Commander - Platinum Edition (1992)(Mindscape)(Disk 1 of 3)[h LSD][a].adf:InstallWingCommander:0:03C0
name: query_volume_info_with_lock
description: Locks a path, queries volume information with the dos library and unlocks it, with memory allocated and freed around the call. It saves the caller's registers into a stack frame first and calls three unnamed routines.

key: wing commander - platinum edition (1992)(mindscape)(disk 1 of 3)[h lsd][a]/Wing Commander - Platinum Edition (1992)(Mindscape)(Disk 1 of 3)[h LSD][a].adf:InstallWingCommander:0:045E
name: find_table_entry_by_id
description: Scans a table of sixteen-byte entries and returns the first entry whose stored identifier matches the argument, or zero when none does. When the stack check fails it defers the search to an unnamed routine instead.

key: wing commander - platinum edition (1992)(mindscape)(disk 1 of 3)[h lsd][a]/Wing Commander - Platinum Edition (1992)(Mindscape)(Disk 1 of 3)[h LSD][a].adf:InstallWingCommander:0:04A6
name: process_typed_table_entries
description: Walks a table of sixteen-byte entries and, for entries whose type byte is 2 or 4, calls helper routines with the entry's identifier. A stack-space check defers the work to unnamed routines when space is short.

key: wing commander - platinum edition (1992)(mindscape)(disk 1 of 3)[h lsd][a]/Wing Commander - Platinum Edition (1992)(Mindscape)(Disk 1 of 3)[h LSD][a].adf:InstallWingCommander:0:05FA
name: copy_file_and_set_protection
description: Opens a file with the dos library, examines it and reads its contents into allocated memory, then writes them out. It sets the file's protection bits and closes the handles, with two unnamed routines doing part of the work.

key: wing commander - platinum edition (1992)(mindscape)(disk 1 of 3)[h lsd][a]/Wing Commander - Platinum Edition (1992)(Mindscape)(Disk 1 of 3)[h LSD][a].adf:InstallWingCommander:0:073C
name: scan_string_against_install_buffer
description: Copies a string into a fixed buffer in the install state, then scans it to the end and compares its characters with the argument string. Six unnamed helpers support the work, and no library calls are listed.

key: wing commander - platinum edition (1992)(mindscape)(disk 1 of 3)[h lsd][a]/Wing Commander - Platinum Edition (1992)(Mindscape)(Disk 1 of 3)[h LSD][a].adf:InstallWingCommander:0:07FE
name: create_directory_if_missing
description: Examines a path with a lock first and creates the directory when the examine does not find it. It uses a 257-byte path buffer on the stack, frees its temporary memory and calls three unnamed routines.

key: wing commander - platinum edition (1992)(mindscape)(disk 1 of 3)[h lsd][a]/Wing Commander - Platinum Edition (1992)(Mindscape)(Disk 1 of 3)[h LSD][a].adf:InstallWingCommander:0:0970
name: stub_return_without_work
description: The entry is eight instructions long, but its pseudo-code shows only a return. It performs no work and returns to its single caller.

key: wing commander - platinum edition (1992)(mindscape)(disk 1 of 3)[h lsd][a]/Wing Commander - Platinum Edition (1992)(Mindscape)(Disk 1 of 3)[h LSD][a].adf:InstallWingCommander:0:0988
name: stub_no_op_return
description: Eight-instruction entry whose only effect is an immediate return to its single caller.

key: wing commander - platinum edition (1992)(mindscape)(disk 1 of 3)[h lsd][a]/Wing Commander - Platinum Edition (1992)(Mindscape)(Disk 1 of 3)[h LSD][a].adf:InstallWingCommander:0:09A0
name: free_linked_memory_blocks
description: Frees each node of a linked list through the exec free-memory call, clears the list head, then releases the remaining entries of a second list. It returns the result of the last free call.

key: wing commander - platinum edition (1992)(mindscape)(disk 1 of 3)[h lsd][a]/Wing Commander - Platinum Edition (1992)(Mindscape)(Disk 1 of 3)[h LSD][a].adf:InstallWingCommander:0:0A20
name: split_slash_path_into_segments
description: Splits a path on forward slashes by writing a zero at each separator and recording the start of each segment in an array of up to sixteen entries. A backslash skips the following character, and the routine returns minus one for a malformed or over-long path.

key: wing commander - platinum edition (1992)(mindscape)(disk 1 of 3)[h lsd][a]/Wing Commander - Platinum Edition (1992)(Mindscape)(Disk 1 of 3)[h LSD][a].adf:InstallWingCommander:0:0AA8
name: split_path_into_name_parts
description: Copies a path into a 63-byte local buffer and scans it backwards for a dot, slash or colon to separate the name from the directory and extension parts. It writes zero terminators into the optional output buffers and calls one unnamed routine.

key: wing commander - platinum edition (1992)(mindscape)(disk 1 of 3)[h lsd][a]/Wing Commander - Platinum Edition (1992)(Mindscape)(Disk 1 of 3)[h LSD][a].adf:InstallWingCommander:0:0C20
name: append_path_separator_if_needed
description: Finds the end of a path string and appends a separator byte from a global when the last character is not already a slash, colon or backslash. It then calls one unnamed routine.

key: wing commander - platinum edition (1992)(mindscape)(disk 1 of 3)[h lsd][a]/Wing Commander - Platinum Edition (1992)(Mindscape)(Disk 1 of 3)[h LSD][a].adf:InstallWingCommander:0:0C7C
name: copy_string_return_end_pointer
description: Copies a null-terminated string from the source to the destination, including the terminator, and returns the address where the terminator was written.

key: wing commander - platinum edition (1992)(mindscape)(disk 1 of 3)[h lsd][a]/Wing Commander - Platinum Edition (1992)(Mindscape)(Disk 1 of 3)[h LSD][a].adf:InstallWingCommander:0:0C90
name: format_decimal_digits_to_string
description: Repeatedly calls an unnamed division helper and stores each remainder as an ASCII digit. It then reverses the digits into the output, adds a terminator and returns the string length.

key: wing commander - platinum edition (1992)(mindscape)(disk 1 of 3)[h lsd][a]/Wing Commander - Platinum Edition (1992)(Mindscape)(Disk 1 of 3)[h LSD][a].adf:InstallWingCommander:0:0CC0
name: format_octal_digits_to_string
description: Converts an unsigned value to octal digits by taking three bits at a time, reverses them into the output, adds a terminator and returns the length.

key: wing commander - platinum edition (1992)(mindscape)(disk 1 of 3)[h lsd][a]/Wing Commander - Platinum Edition (1992)(Mindscape)(Disk 1 of 3)[h LSD][a].adf:InstallWingCommander:0:0D00
name: format_hex_digits_to_string
description: Converts an unsigned value into lower-case hexadecimal digits using a sixteen-character lookup table. It reverses the digits into the output, adds a zero terminator and returns the length.

key: wing commander - platinum edition (1992)(mindscape)(disk 1 of 3)[h lsd][a]/Wing Commander - Platinum Edition (1992)(Mindscape)(Disk 1 of 3)[h LSD][a].adf:InstallWingCommander:0:0D2C
name: parse_signed_decimal_into_pointer
description: Reads an optional plus or minus sign and decimal digits from a string, stores the signed value through the second pointer, and returns the number of characters consumed.

key: wing commander - platinum edition (1992)(mindscape)(disk 1 of 3)[h lsd][a]/Wing Commander - Platinum Edition (1992)(Mindscape)(Disk 1 of 3)[h LSD][a].adf:InstallWingCommander:0:0D7C
name: allocate_buffer_or_set_error
description: When a flag bit is clear, it allocates a buffer through an unnamed routine and stores it in two fields of the structure. On failure it records error code twelve in a global and returns minus one; on success it clears two counters and returns zero.

key: wing commander - platinum edition (1992)(mindscape)(disk 1 of 3)[h lsd][a]/Wing Commander - Platinum Edition (1992)(Mindscape)(Disk 1 of 3)[h LSD][a].adf:InstallWingCommander:0:0DC4
name: uppercase_string_in_place
description: Walks a null-terminated string and converts each lower-case letter to upper case in place. A character-class table in the global state decides which characters qualify.

key: wing commander - platinum edition (1992)(mindscape)(disk 1 of 3)[h lsd][a]/Wing Commander - Platinum Edition (1992)(Mindscape)(Disk 1 of 3)[h LSD][a].adf:InstallWingCommander:0:0E08
name: write_buffered_data_to_handle
description: Writes data through the dos library after checking the handle's mode bits, and records any dos error in a global. It handles buffered chunks in a loop with six unnamed helpers, and a handle that fails the mode check records an error code and returns five.

key: wing commander - platinum edition (1992)(mindscape)(disk 1 of 3)[h lsd][a]/Wing Commander - Platinum Edition (1992)(Mindscape)(Disk 1 of 3)[h LSD][a].adf:InstallWingCommander:0:0EFA
name: check_handle_mode_then_call
description: Checks that a handle exists and has bit one set, otherwise it records an error code and returns minus one. For a valid handle it calls a library routine through the stored library base and records a further error on failure.

key: wing commander - platinum edition (1992)(mindscape)(disk 1 of 3)[h lsd][a]/Wing Commander - Platinum Edition (1992)(Mindscape)(Disk 1 of 3)[h LSD][a].adf:InstallWingCommander:0:0F08
name: read_from_handle_checked
description: Checks a handle's mode bits, then reads data from it through the dos library and records dos error codes in globals. Four unnamed routines support the buffering, and the routine returns the count read or minus one.

key: wing commander - platinum edition (1992)(mindscape)(disk 1 of 3)[h lsd][a]/Wing Commander - Platinum Edition (1992)(Mindscape)(Disk 1 of 3)[h LSD][a].adf:InstallWingCommander:0:1002
name: seek_handle_checked
description: Validates a handle, then seeks within it through the dos library using the mode argument, recording any dos error. Two unnamed routines are also called.

key: wing commander - platinum edition (1992)(mindscape)(disk 1 of 3)[h lsd][a]/Wing Commander - Platinum Edition (1992)(Mindscape)(Disk 1 of 3)[h LSD][a].adf:InstallWingCommander:0:108C
name: close_handle_and_clear_slot
description: Closes an open file handle through the dos library and returns zero; an invalid handle returns minus one. A handle flagged as a special type is only marked closed, and four unnamed routines support the work.

key: wing commander - platinum edition (1992)(mindscape)(disk 1 of 3)[h lsd][a]/Wing Commander - Platinum Edition (1992)(Mindscape)(Disk 1 of 3)[h LSD][a].adf:InstallWingCommander:0:10F4
name: open_install_file_with_protection
description: Adds a node to the open-file list, allocating one when no free node exists, then opens the named file through the dos library and applies protection bits. It also opens intuition.library through the exec library as part of its setup, reporting failures through error codes.

key: wing commander - platinum edition (1992)(mindscape)(disk 1 of 3)[h lsd][a]/Wing Commander - Platinum Edition (1992)(Mindscape)(Disk 1 of 3)[h LSD][a].adf:InstallWingCommander:0:13A2
name: divide_fixed_point_values
description: Divides one 32-bit value by another using 16-bit halves and a shift chosen from the divisor's size. It returns the quotient and remainder packed into a single 64-bit result.

key: wing commander - platinum edition (1992)(mindscape)(disk 1 of 3)[h lsd][a]/Wing Commander - Platinum Edition (1992)(Mindscape)(Disk 1 of 3)[h LSD][a].adf:InstallWingCommander:0:1434
name: multiply_32bit_via_halves
description: Multiplies two 32-bit values from the data registers by combining the cross products of their 16-bit halves with the low-half product. It returns the 32-bit result.

key: wing commander - platinum edition (1992)(mindscape)(disk 1 of 3)[h lsd][a]/Wing Commander - Platinum Edition (1992)(Mindscape)(Disk 1 of 3)[h LSD][a].adf:InstallWingCommander:0:1454
name: stub_empty_return_routine
description: The pseudo-code shows only a return, while the facts list 25 instructions and one unnamed call, so only the return is claimed. Nine unnamed routines call it.

key: wing commander - platinum edition (1992)(mindscape)(disk 1 of 3)[h lsd][a]/Wing Commander - Platinum Edition (1992)(Mindscape)(Disk 1 of 3)[h LSD][a].adf:InstallWingCommander:0:1498
name: close_or_notify_open_handles
description: Sets a status flag and walks the open-file list. For nodes with the closing flag it calls the dos close routine, and for other nodes it invokes the stored callback, then runs one unnamed routine.

key: wing commander - platinum edition (1992)(mindscape)(disk 1 of 3)[h lsd][a]/Wing Commander - Platinum Edition (1992)(Mindscape)(Disk 1 of 3)[h LSD][a].adf:InstallWingCommander:0:14F0
name: parse_command_line_into_args
description: Splits the command line into up to thirty-two arguments, treating quoted text as a single argument. The NIL: text reference and the dos input and output calls show it can redirect the standard streams.

key: wing commander - platinum edition (1992)(mindscape)(disk 1 of 3)[h lsd][a]/Wing Commander - Platinum Edition (1992)(Mindscape)(Disk 1 of 3)[h LSD][a].adf:InstallWingCommander:0:178E
name: copy_message_text_to_stack
description: Copies up to seventy-nine characters of a string from the caller's state into a stack buffer and terminates it. When a task structure lookup returns a non-null entry, it passes the buffer to an unnamed routine.

key: wing commander - platinum edition (1992)(mindscape)(disk 1 of 3)[h lsd][a]/Wing Commander - Platinum Edition (1992)(Mindscape)(Disk 1 of 3)[h LSD][a].adf:InstallWingCommander:0:1794
name: print_break_message_to_output
description: Copies a message of up to seventy-nine characters into a stack buffer, looks up the current task and writes the text, with a break prefix, through the dos library. It also tries to open intuition.library through the exec library.

key: wing commander - platinum edition (1992)(mindscape)(disk 1 of 3)[h lsd][a]/Wing Commander - Platinum Edition (1992)(Mindscape)(Disk 1 of 3)[h LSD][a].adf:InstallWingCommander:0:18E0
name: get_list_node_by_index
description: Returns the node at the given index in the list rooted in the state, or null when the index is negative or past the count. It records an error code for an out-of-range index or a missing node.

key: wing commander - platinum edition (1992)(mindscape)(disk 1 of 3)[h lsd][a]/Wing Commander - Platinum Edition (1992)(Mindscape)(Disk 1 of 3)[h LSD][a].adf:InstallWingCommander:0:1928
name: check_break_signal_and_report
description: Calls SetSignal to read the signal mask. If the Ctrl-C or Ctrl-D break bits are set and no break has been handled yet, it copies the status text and reports the break through an unnamed routine.

key: wing commander - platinum edition (1992)(mindscape)(disk 1 of 3)[h lsd][a]/Wing Commander - Platinum Edition (1992)(Mindscape)(Disk 1 of 3)[h LSD][a].adf:InstallWingCommander:0:1984
name: find_byte_in_buffer
description: Scans a buffer of the given length for a target byte and returns a pointer to the first match, or null when the length runs out without one.

key: wing commander - platinum edition (1992)(mindscape)(disk 1 of 3)[h lsd][a]/Wing Commander - Platinum Edition (1992)(Mindscape)(Disk 1 of 3)[h LSD][a].adf:InstallWingCommander:0:19A8
name: append_string_to_buffer
description: Appends a source string to the end of a destination string, copying no more characters than the count passed in the data register and always writing a terminator.

key: wing commander - platinum edition (1992)(mindscape)(disk 1 of 3)[h lsd][a]/Wing Commander - Platinum Edition (1992)(Mindscape)(Disk 1 of 3)[h LSD][a].adf:InstallWingCommander:0:19C0
name: concatenate_strings_unbounded
description: Finds the terminating zero of the destination string and copies the source string, including its terminator, onto that point. It returns the original destination pointer.

key: wing commander - platinum edition (1992)(mindscape)(disk 1 of 3)[h lsd][a]/Wing Commander - Platinum Edition (1992)(Mindscape)(Disk 1 of 3)[h LSD][a].adf:InstallWingCommander:0:19E4
name: copy_string_padded_to_count
description: Copies a null-terminated source into the destination, stopping at its terminator or at the count, then fills the rest of the count with zero bytes.

key: wing commander - platinum edition (1992)(mindscape)(disk 1 of 3)[h lsd][a]/Wing Commander - Platinum Edition (1992)(Mindscape)(Disk 1 of 3)[h LSD][a].adf:InstallWingCommander:0:1A08
name: move_byte_block_overlap_safe
description: Copies a block of bytes of the given length, choosing forward or backward order so that overlapping source and destination regions are copied correctly.

key: wing commander - platinum edition (1992)(mindscape)(disk 1 of 3)[h lsd][a]/Wing Commander - Platinum Edition (1992)(Mindscape)(Disk 1 of 3)[h LSD][a].adf:InstallWingCommander:0:1A28
name: release_pool_block_checked
description: Frees a block from the state's memory pool after checking that its address lies inside a recorded region, recording error code twenty-two when it does not. The one-instruction count in the facts does not match the longer pseudo-code.

key: wing commander - platinum edition (1992)(mindscape)(disk 1 of 3)[h lsd][a]/Wing Commander - Platinum Edition (1992)(Mindscape)(Disk 1 of 3)[h LSD][a].adf:InstallWingCommander:0:1A2C
name: free_pool_block_via_exec
description: Performs the same region check as its neighbour, then returns the block to exec through the free-memory call. An address outside every region records error code twenty-two.

key: wing commander - platinum edition (1992)(mindscape)(disk 1 of 3)[h lsd][a]/Wing Commander - Platinum Edition (1992)(Mindscape)(Disk 1 of 3)[h LSD][a].adf:InstallWingCommander:0:1B94
name: allocate_pool_block_from_region
description: Rounds the requested size up to a multiple of four and searches the recorded pool regions for a free block of that size. A zero request or a size above the pool limit records error code twenty-two and returns null.

key: wing commander - platinum edition (1992)(mindscape)(disk 1 of 3)[h lsd][a]/Wing Commander - Platinum Edition (1992)(Mindscape)(Disk 1 of 3)[h LSD][a].adf:InstallWingCommander:0:1B98
name: allocate_pool_block_or_alloc
description: Uses the same rounding and pool search as its neighbour. When no pooled block fits, it obtains memory through exec.AllocMem before returning the block.

key: wing commander - platinum edition (1992)(mindscape)(disk 1 of 3)[h lsd][a]/Wing Commander - Platinum Edition (1992)(Mindscape)(Disk 1 of 3)[h LSD][a].adf:InstallWingCommander:0:1D0C
name: close_all_open_streams
description: Runs the registered callbacks, then closes or notifies each node in the stream list and sets the closing flag. Two unnamed routines are also called during the sequence.

key: wing commander - platinum edition (1992)(mindscape)(disk 1 of 3)[h lsd][a]/Wing Commander - Platinum Edition (1992)(Mindscape)(Disk 1 of 3)[h LSD][a].adf:InstallWingCommander:0:1D5C
name: append_byte_to_fill_buffer
description: Stores a byte at the current fill position of a buffer and increments the count. When the count passes 511 it flushes the buffer through an unnamed routine and resets the count to zero.

key: wing commander - platinum edition (1992)(mindscape)(disk 1 of 3)[h lsd][a]/Wing Commander - Platinum Edition (1992)(Mindscape)(Disk 1 of 3)[h LSD][a].adf:InstallWingCommander:0:1D8E
name: return_status_from_flags
description: Calls one unnamed routine with a stack-frame argument, then returns minus one when bits four or five of a flag word are set and zero otherwise.

key: wing commander - platinum edition (1992)(mindscape)(disk 1 of 3)[h lsd][a]/Wing Commander - Platinum Edition (1992)(Mindscape)(Disk 1 of 3)[h LSD][a].adf:InstallWingCommander:0:1DD8
name: read_line_into_buffer
description: Reads characters from the stream into a buffer until a newline or end of input, then terminates the buffer. It returns the buffer, or null when nothing was read.

key: wing commander - platinum edition (1992)(mindscape)(disk 1 of 3)[h lsd][a]/Wing Commander - Platinum Edition (1992)(Mindscape)(Disk 1 of 3)[h LSD][a].adf:InstallWingCommander:0:1E40
name: read_next_byte_from_stream
description: Returns the next byte from a buffered stream, or minus one at end of input. When the buffer is empty it reads more through unnamed helpers and sets the error or end flags when a read fails.

key: wing commander - platinum edition (1992)(mindscape)(disk 1 of 3)[h lsd][a]/Wing Commander - Platinum Edition (1992)(Mindscape)(Disk 1 of 3)[h LSD][a].adf:InstallWingCommander:0:1FA4
name: compute_stream_position
description: Works out a stream position from a read result: when a flag is set it subtracts the number of newline characters counted in the buffer, and otherwise it subtracts the remaining buffered count. An unset node returns minus one.

key: wing commander - platinum edition (1992)(mindscape)(disk 1 of 3)[h lsd][a]/Wing Commander - Platinum Edition (1992)(Mindscape)(Disk 1 of 3)[h LSD][a].adf:InstallWingCommander:0:1FA8
name: compute_stream_position_from_node
description: Follows the same position calculation as its neighbour for a node passed in its argument, using the flag and buffered count stored in the node.

key: wing commander - platinum edition (1992)(mindscape)(disk 1 of 3)[h lsd][a]/Wing Commander - Platinum Edition (1992)(Mindscape)(Disk 1 of 3)[h LSD][a].adf:InstallWingCommander:0:2034
name: reset_stream_buffer_state
description: Resets a stream's buffer pointers and counters to their starting values, clears a status byte and runs a flush step through unnamed routines. It returns minus one when that flush fails and zero otherwise.

name: check_stream_access_mode
description: Checks a stream's mode bits for the access requested. When access is refused it marks the stream and returns zero; otherwise it passes control to an unnamed helper and returns its result.

key: wing commander - platinum edition (1992)(mindscape)(disk 1 of 3)[h lsd][a]/Wing Commander - Platinum Edition (1992)(Mindscape)(Disk 1 of 3)[h LSD][a].adf:InstallWingCommander:0:20BC
name: check_stream_access_and_write
description: Checks the stream's mode bits in the same way as its neighbour, returning zero when access is refused. It takes two pointer arguments and calls five unnamed routines for the rest of the work.

key: wing commander - platinum edition (1992)(mindscape)(disk 1 of 3)[h lsd][a]/Wing Commander - Platinum Edition (1992)(Mindscape)(Disk 1 of 3)[h LSD][a].adf:InstallWingCommander:0:21E8
name: check_stream_access_and_read
description: Checks the stream mode bits for a read request and returns zero when access is refused. Otherwise it calls an unnamed routine and records the buffer state, using four unnamed routines in all.

key: wing commander - platinum edition (1992)(mindscape)(disk 1 of 3)[h lsd][a]/Wing Commander - Platinum Edition (1992)(Mindscape)(Disk 1 of 3)[h LSD][a].adf:InstallWingCommander:0:2360
name: update_stream_node_state
description: With a null node it walks the stream list and returns minus one if any helper reports a problem. Otherwise it checks the node's flags, resets its buffer state and counters, and returns zero or a status from the helpers.

key: wing commander - platinum edition (1992)(mindscape)(disk 1 of 3)[h lsd][a]/Wing Commander - Platinum Edition (1992)(Mindscape)(Disk 1 of 3)[h LSD][a].adf:InstallWingCommander:0:2430
name: flush_and_release_stream_node
description: Returns minus one for a null or unopened node. Otherwise it flushes buffered output through an unnamed routine when needed, clears the node's pointer, releases it and returns zero or minus one depending on those results.

key: wing commander - platinum edition (1992)(mindscape)(disk 1 of 3)[h lsd][a]/Wing Commander - Platinum Edition (1992)(Mindscape)(Disk 1 of 3)[h LSD][a].adf:InstallWingCommander:0:2434
name: close_stream_node_if_open
description: Returns minus one for a null or closed node. Otherwise it flushes pending output through an unnamed routine when the flag is set, clears the node's state and calls a second routine; minus one is returned if either step fails.

key: wing commander - platinum edition (1992)(mindscape)(disk 1 of 3)[h lsd][a]/Wing Commander - Platinum Edition (1992)(Mindscape)(Disk 1 of 3)[h LSD][a].adf:InstallWingCommander:0:249E
name: parse_file_open_mode
description: Reads a file-open mode string with read, write or append letters and optional plus and binary markers, and converts it into access flags. An unknown first letter returns zero, and a valid mode is passed on to an unnamed routine that opens the file.

key: wing commander - platinum edition (1992)(mindscape)(disk 1 of 3)[h lsd][a]/Wing Commander - Platinum Edition (1992)(Mindscape)(Disk 1 of 3)[h LSD][a].adf:InstallWingCommander:0:25D4
name: find_or_allocate_free_node
description: Finds the first unused node in a list, or allocates and zero-fills a new node when none is free, then passes the node to an unnamed routine. It returns that routine's result, or zero when allocation fails.

key: wing commander - platinum edition (1992)(mindscape)(disk 1 of 3)[h lsd][a]/Wing Commander - Platinum Edition (1992)(Mindscape)(Disk 1 of 3)[h LSD][a].adf:InstallWingCommander:0:264C
name: format_string_with_arguments
description: Walks a format string, reading flags, width and conversion letters, and converts the matching argument values into text using six unnamed helpers. It returns a pointer into the format string after the conversion it handled.

key: wing commander - platinum edition (1992)(mindscape)(disk 1 of 3)[h lsd][a]/Wing Commander - Platinum Edition (1992)(Mindscape)(Disk 1 of 3)[h LSD][a].adf:InstallWingCommander:0:2A84
name: emit_format_text_characters
description: Walks a format string, passing ordinary characters to an output routine and treating a doubled percent sign as one literal percent sign. Other conversions go to an unnamed formatter that returns the next position, and the routine returns at the end of the string.

key: wing commander - platinum edition (1992)(mindscape)(disk 1 of 3)[h lsd][a]/Wing Commander - Platinum Edition (1992)(Mindscape)(Disk 1 of 3)[h LSD][a].adf:InstallWingCommander:0:2AF0
name: delete_file_checked
description: Calls the dos library delete routine. When the delete fails it records the dos error code in a global, and it returns true for a failed delete.

key: wing commander - platinum edition (1992)(mindscape)(disk 1 of 3)[h lsd][a]/Wing Commander - Platinum Edition (1992)(Mindscape)(Disk 1 of 3)[h LSD][a].adf:InstallWingCommander:0:2B20
name: stub_empty_return_two
description: A 36-instruction routine whose pseudo-code is only a return, with four unnamed callers. The instruction count is larger than the code shown, so no work is claimed.

key: wing commander - platinum edition (1992)(mindscape)(disk 1 of 3)[h lsd][a]/Wing Commander - Platinum Edition (1992)(Mindscape)(Disk 1 of 3)[h LSD][a].adf:InstallWingCommander:0:2B7C
name: call_unnamed_routine_then_return
description: Calls one unnamed routine and returns, with no other work. That routine is its only caller.

key: wing commander - platinum edition (1992)(mindscape)(disk 1 of 3)[h lsd][a]/Wing Commander - Platinum Edition (1992)(Mindscape)(Disk 1 of 3)[h LSD][a].adf:Wing:0:0000
name: free_blocks_restore_patch_a
description: Program entry for the Wing executable that calls two unnamed routines and frees a short run of memory blocks through exec.FreeMem. It then clears a stored longword and, when a stored value matches a fixed bit pattern, restores the saved value.

key: wing commander - platinum edition (1992)(mindscape)(disk 1 of 3)[h lsd][a]/Wing Commander - Platinum Edition (1992)(Mindscape)(Disk 1 of 3)[h LSD][a].adf:Wing:0:0064
name: busy_wait_16bit_countdown
description: Loops, decrementing a 16-bit counter until it wraps past zero to minus one. It keeps the processor busy for a fixed number of iterations and returns.

key: wing commander - platinum edition (1992)(mindscape)(disk 1 of 3)[h lsd][a]/Wing Commander - Platinum Edition (1992)(Mindscape)(Disk 1 of 3)[h LSD][a].adf:bootblock:0:01CC
name: iterate_records_calling_library
description: Walks a sequence of length-prefixed records until a zero byte, calling one library routine for each record and a second library routine after it.

name: busy_wait_countdown_loop
description: Loops, decrementing a 16-bit counter until it wraps to minus one, which burns a fixed number of iterations before returning.

description: Program entry for the AGA patch. Like its neighbours, it frees a short run of memory blocks through exec.FreeMem, then clears a stored longword and restores a saved value when a fixed bit pattern matches.

key: colonization (1995)(microprose)(m3)[h pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Colonization (1995)(MicroProse)(M3)[h PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:C/SetPatchAGA:0:0064
name: busy_wait_countdown_short
description: Loops, decrementing a 16-bit counter until it wraps to minus one, then returns. It has no other effect on data or registers.

name: copy_table_block_then_call
description: If the output pointer is non-null, copies sixteen longwords from a fixed table in the caller's base into it. It then calls a stored routine.

name: compute_maximum_list_value
description: Program entry that calls a stored routine, then walks a linked list of entries and keeps a running maximum of the stored values. It calls the stored routine again and, when the result is non-zero, writes the maximum into a fixed slot together with a constant tag word.

key: colonization (1995)(microprose)(m3)[h pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Colonization (1995)(MicroProse)(M3)[h PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:C/EndCLI:0:0136
name: copy_table_block_and_call
description: Performs the same conditional copy of sixteen longwords from the fixed table as its neighbour, then calls a stored routine.

key: colonization (1995)(microprose)(m3)[h pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Colonization (1995)(MicroProse)(M3)[h PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:C/Echo:0:0000
name: compute_maximum_list_value_alt
description: Program entry that follows the same sequence as its neighbour: a stored call, a walk over a linked list tracking the largest value, then a second call and a conditional store with a constant tag.

key: colonization (1995)(microprose)(m3)[h pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Colonization (1995)(MicroProse)(M3)[h PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:C/Echo:0:0136
name: copy_table_block_call_alt
description: Copies sixteen longwords from a fixed table into the output pointer when it is non-null, then calls a stored routine. It is the same routine as its neighbour.

key: colonization (1995)(microprose)(m3)[h pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Colonization (1995)(MicroProse)(M3)[h PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:C/FastMemFirst:0:0000
name: startup_open_dos_message_handshake
description: Program entry that allocates a memory block, finds the current task and opens dos.library, returning an error code when a step fails. It waits on a message port, replies to the message and releases its resources in cleanup, with one unnamed routine doing the main work.

key: colonization (1995)(microprose)(m3)[h pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Colonization (1995)(MicroProse)(M3)[h PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:C/FastMemFirst:2:0000
name: select_memory_blocks_by_type
description: Walks a list of memory blocks and selects the first block with type tag five in one address range, and the first block with type tag three below a second limit. When both are found and differ, it calls unnamed routines on them and passes the list head to a further routine.

key: colonization (1995)(microprose)(m3)[h pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Colonization (1995)(MicroProse)(M3)[h PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:C/If:0:0000
name: compute_maximum_list_value_if
description: Program entry that calls a stored routine, walks a linked list keeping the largest stored value, then calls the routine again. On a non-zero result it writes that maximum, with a constant tag word, into a fixed slot.

key: colonization (1995)(microprose)(m3)[h pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Colonization (1995)(MicroProse)(M3)[h PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:C/If:0:0136
name: copy_table_block_call_if
description: If the output pointer is non-null, copies sixteen longwords from a fixed table in the caller's base into it, then calls a stored routine.

key: colonization (1995)(microprose)(m3)[h pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Colonization (1995)(MicroProse)(M3)[h PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:C/LoadWB:0:0000
name: startup_open_nil_and_dos
description: Program entry that allocates a memory block, finds the current task and opens dos.library. It opens the NIL: device name through dos, then waits on a message port and calls two unnamed routines for the main work.

key: colonization (1995)(microprose)(m3)[h pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Colonization (1995)(MicroProse)(M3)[h PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:C/LoadWB:0:01A0
name: restore_slot_and_release_resources
description: Retrieves the per-task structure, stores its argument in a slot and returns it. Before returning it runs cleanup for stored pointers, which includes closing a handle, freeing memory and replying to a message, and it calls one more library routine when a further field is set.

key: colonization (1995)(microprose)(m3)[h pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Colonization (1995)(MicroProse)(M3)[h PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:C/LoadWB:2:0000
name: decode_strings_and_start_tool
description: Decodes obfuscated strings by XOR-ing them with a fixed byte, then looks up named resources such as Workbench and intuition.library. It reports errors such as a missing resident tag or a tool that cannot start, using many library routines and eight unnamed routines.

key: colonization (1995)(microprose)(m3)[h pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Colonization (1995)(MicroProse)(M3)[h PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:C/LoadWB:2:022A
name: compare_strings_ordered_result
description: Compares two null-terminated strings byte by byte and returns minus one when the first sorts lower, one when it sorts higher, and zero when they are equal.

key: colonization (1995)(microprose)(m3)[h pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Colonization (1995)(MicroProse)(M3)[h PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:C/LoadWB:2:0250
name: build_node_list_from_table
description: Walks an index-linked table, allocating an eight-byte node for each entry, copying a value into it and chaining the nodes together. It returns the head of the new list, or the nodes built so far when an allocation or lookup fails.

description: Compares a text buffer with a stored string and, when the marker byte at offset twenty is the character two and the strings match, writes a period and four spaces at offset seventeen. The referenced text names Workbench release 1.2.

key: colonization (1995)(microprose)(m3)[h pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Colonization (1995)(MicroProse)(M3)[h PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:C/LoadWB:4:0028
name: write_period_padding_bytes
description: Writes a period followed by four spaces into a text buffer at a fixed position, and returns.

key: colonization (1995)(microprose)(m3)[h pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Colonization (1995)(MicroProse)(M3)[h PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:C/LoadWB:4:0048

description: Advances through a text buffer while its bytes equal a stored string, stopping when the stored string ends. It returns with the buffer pointer moved past the matched prefix.

name: stub_empty_return_three
description: A four-instruction routine that performs no operation and returns. It has three unnamed callers.

name: forward_args_with_stack_slot
description: Passes its two arguments to one unnamed routine together with the address of a stack slot, then returns.

key: colonization (1995)(microprose)(m3)[h pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Colonization (1995)(MicroProse)(M3)[h PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:C/LoadWB:8:0000

description: Formats text into a 140-byte stack buffer using the exec formatted-output routine, then measures the result. When the string is not empty it passes the buffer and its length to one unnamed routine.

key: colonization (1995)(microprose)(m3)[h pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Colonization (1995)(MicroProse)(M3)[h PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:C/Version:0:0000
name: version_startup_open_dos
description: Program entry that allocates memory, finds the current task and opens dos.library, returning an error code when allocation fails. It waits on and replies to a port message, and calls two unnamed routines for the main work, with an alert call among its library calls.

key: colonization (1995)(microprose)(m3)[h pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Colonization (1995)(MicroProse)(M3)[h PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:C/Version:0:0172
name: store_slot_and_release_resources
description: Stores its argument in a task-level slot and returns the slot's value after running cleanup calls for stored pointers. When a second field is set it calls two further library routines, and its library calls include closing a library, freeing memory and replying to a message.

key: colonization (1995)(microprose)(m3)[h pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Colonization (1995)(MicroProse)(M3)[h PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:C/Version:2:0000
name: parse_args_and_report_versions
description: Parses command-line arguments, prints a usage line when asked and opens the requested library or device. It compares version and revision numbers with the arguments and prints Kickstart, Workbench or device version messages, using four library calls and nine unnamed routines.

key: colonization (1995)(microprose)(m3)[h pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Colonization (1995)(MicroProse)(M3)[h PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:C/Version:2:0352
name: call_flagged_then_forward_second
description: Calls one unnamed routine with the first argument and the fixed value 128, then passes the second argument to another unnamed routine.

name: parse_signed_integer_text
description: Converts a string to an integer by reading an optional plus or minus sign and then decimal digits. The result is negated for a minus sign and returned.

key: colonization (1995)(microprose)(m3)[h pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Colonization (1995)(MicroProse)(M3)[h PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:C/Version:2:03EE
name: compare_null_terminated_text
description: Compares two null-terminated strings byte by byte. It returns minus one when the first sorts lower, one when it sorts higher, and zero when they are equal.

key: colonization (1995)(microprose)(m3)[h pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Colonization (1995)(MicroProse)(M3)[h PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:C/Version:2:0414
name: measure_string_length_version
description: Walks a null-terminated string and returns the count of characters before the terminator.

description: Calls the exec library routine at offset 552 from the exec base held in a global, and returns its result. It is a single relay with no other work.

name: store_byte_at_output_pointer
description: Stores the low byte of the data register at the location given by the address register and returns. Its shape is that of a character-output callback, and the facts show one caller and no library calls.

name: initialize_chain_records_on_start
description: Program entry that allocates memory through exec and walks a linked chain of records that starts at a fixed address, filling the records with computed values. It uses a constant pair of values, calls an empty routine and five unnamed routines.

key: colonization (1995)(microprose)(m3)[h pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Colonization (1995)(MicroProse)(M3)[h PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:Colonization:0:0124
name: find_masked_table_entry_bit
description: Scans a table of word pairs until a masked key matches the second word of a pair. It then reads a byte from that entry and extracts a bit from a mask using a shift taken from the entry, calling an unnamed routine instead when a comparison borrow is detected.

key: colonization (1995)(microprose)(m3)[h pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Colonization (1995)(MicroProse)(M3)[h PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:Colonization:0:015E
name: mask_word_or_call_fallback
description: ANDs a word with a mask. When the first byte is less than the second, it calls an unnamed routine and returns that routine's word in place of the masked value.

name: stub_empty_return_four
description: A twelve-instruction routine that performs no operation and returns. It has two unnamed callers.

key: colonization (1995)(microprose)(m3)[h pdx](disk 1 of 3)/Colonization (1995)(MicroProse)(M3)[h PDX](Disk 1 of 3).adf:Colonization:0:0182
name: build_bit_mask_table
description: Reads a count and fills a byte buffer with values from the input routine, then loops over the entries writing bit masks and derived values into a table. It calls one unnamed routine during the loop.
